sloka: अनेन धर्मशीलेन वनात् प्रत्यागत: पुन: ।भ्रात्रा सह भविष्यामि पृथिव्या: पतिरुत्तम: ॥ २.१११.३१॥
transliteration: anena dharmaśīlena vanāt pratyāgata: puna: ।bhrātrā saha bhaviṣyāmi pṛthivyā: patiruttama: ॥ 2.111.31॥

translations.english: On returning from the forest, I shall become the supreme lord of this earth along with this virtuous brother.
